items.q: Harry Fleming who was a famous dancer, who I knew

ctx.x: We doubled in -- he had a garden, another establishment, which he called the Taxim Gardens. He had the Petite Chaut. And the Taxim Gardens was further out, I'd say it's about two or three kilometers out from Constantinople.
